name: trenchcoons
description: Two broke raccoons in pursuit of a driving liscence end up on their most trecherous test yet: stranded on an island with SCARY FOXES. Coordinate your driving skills and ESCAPE ALIVE!!!

scripts.shots:serve: vite build && vite preview --port 4173 & sleep 3 && BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4173 node tools/shots.mjs
scripts.gate: f=0; for g in raccoon structure shadow hue distinct regress palette water popin; do npm run -s $g || f=1; done; exit $f
scripts.raccoon:ortho: node tools/raccoon-export.mjs && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/raccoon-ortho.py 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'PROFILE BOUNDS|ORTHO SCALE|STALE|Error'
